definitions.gloss: lecture meeting; public talk; speaking event
definitions.explanation: A formal event where a speaker gives a talk or lecture to an audience. Composed of 講演 (lecture, public speech) + 会 (meeting, gathering).

examples.japanese: {講演会|こうえんかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参加|さんか}した→参加する：25408_sankasuru⟧。
⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な⟦{教授|きょうじゅ}→教授：02589_kyouju⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{講演会|こうえんかい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{開|ひら}かれる→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
examples.english: A lecture by a famous professor will be held.

examples.japanese: ⟦{市民|しみん}→市民：01426_shimin⟧⟦ホール→ホール：11169_hooru⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦テーマ→テーマ：17684_teema⟧にした{講演会|こうえんかい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われ→行う：01238_okonau⟧、{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{集|あつ}まった→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧。
examples.english: A lecture on health was held at the civic hall, and many people gathered.

notes:
USAGE:
{講演会|こうえんかい} refers to a formal public speaking event, typically with an invited speaker addressing an audience on a specific topic. It is common in academic, business, and community settings.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {講演会|こうえんかい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧ (to hold a lecture)
- {講演会|こうえんかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出席|しゅっせき}する→出席する：01830_shussekisuru⟧ (to attend a lecture)
- {講演会|こうえんかい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{講師|こうし}→講師：00451_koushi⟧ (lecturer at a speaking event)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦セミナー→セミナー：11000_seminaa⟧ is a seminar, usually more interactive. シンポジウム is a symposium with multiple speakers. ⟦{講演|こうえん}→講演：02735_kouen⟧ alone refers to the lecture itself rather than the event.
